hints.title: Depth Index Synchronization
hints.text: Maintain the current index i in arr matching the current tree node value.

hints.title: Value Mismatch Pruning
hints.text: If node is null or node value does not equal arr[idx], immediately return false.

hints.title: Leaf Boundary Validation
hints.text: When i reaches len(arr) - 1, the node must be a true leaf (both left and right are null).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Traverses each candidate node along matching paths at most once, with recursion stack bounded by tree height.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting all root-to-leaf paths copies paths explicitly and incurs unnecessary memory overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Early stopping DFS avoids allocating intermediate path buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recursive tree traversal checking index bounds, value equality, and leaf node termination.
